verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that diagnostic settings can route activity logs to several endpoints (docs-9). Downstream systems could consume that log stream, but it is log export rather than a documented webhook or event-hook subscription. Lifecycle workflows (docs-5, docs-18) run automated processes on users but are not shown to emit events to external subscribers. Missing for 10: documented webhook or change-notification subscriptions for user lifecycle and auth events, evidence of real-time delivery, event payload and schema docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
